sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 828)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across two classic newspaper detective mysteries on *Casey, Crime Photographer* for Anchor Hocking Glass (Matt Crowley in 1945; Staats Cotsworth in 1946), Bob Bailey's hardboiled investigations on *Let George Do It* for Standard Oil of California (1947), international post-war debates on *Wake Up America* (1943), exotic storytelling on *Stand By for Adventure* with Douglas Fairbanks Jr. (1946), and boarding school mysteries on *Batman Mystery Club* for the BBC (1950), Fred G. Clark (1943), Matt Crowley (1945), Staats Cotsworth (1946), and Bob Bailey (1947):
